results.name: gap_rule_removed
results.why: the frame gap is not enforced: a source that idles 1 to N/8 - 1 clocks corrupts a frame

results.name: gap_one_short
results.why: tready returns one clock early: N/8 - 1 idle clocks

results.name: gap_one_long
results.why: tready returns one clock late: N/8 + 1 idle clocks (correct data, throughput lost)

results.name: credit_ignored
results.why: frames are accepted although every bank may be in use: the store overflows when the sink stalls

results.name: credit_one_too_many
results.why: NB + 1 frames are allowed in the block

results.name: credit_one_too_few
results.why: only NB - 1 frames are allowed in the block (correct data, throughput lost)

results.name: credit_never_returned
results.why: a finished frame does not give its credit back: the block stops after NB frames

results.name: credit_every_beat
results.why: every input beat takes a credit, not only the first of a frame

results.name: start_polarity
results.why: the start flag follows the wrong polarity of tlast

results.name: direction_ignored
results.why: tuser of the input is not read: every frame is forward

results.name: sof_always
results.why: every beat is a start of frame

results.name: core_sees_unaccepted
results.why: beats are taken that were not accepted (tready low)

results.name: odd_sample_exchanged
results.why: real and imaginary part of the odd sample exchanged on the input

results.name: even_odd_exchanged
results.why: the even and the odd sample exchanged on the input

results.name: done_ignores_ready
results.why: a frame gives its credit back when its last beat is offered, not when it is taken: a stalled sink overflows the store

results.name: core_scaled
results.why: the core runs scaled: the output is 1/N of the unscaled transform in the wide words

results.name: core_natural
results.why: the core reorders to natural order and the store reads bit-reversed: the order is scrambled

results.name: pack_out
results.why: the two samples of an output beat exchanged

results.name: part_out
results.why: real and imaginary parts exchanged on the output

results.name: tuser_zero
results.why: the exponent is not driven on tuser

results.name: exp_off
results.why: the exponent is one too small: the largest part does not fit

results.name: bl_off
results.why: the bit length is one too small

results.name: mag_not_xored
results.why: negative real parts of the even sample are not turned into their ones-complement magnitude: the OR sees the sign bits

results.name: odd_imag_ignored
results.why: the odd sample's imaginary part does not enter the exponent

results.name: acc_not_restarted
results.why: the OR is not cleared at a frame start: the largest earlier frame sets this one's exponent

results.name: round_inverted
results.why: the rounding constant is added in the truncating mode and not in the rounding mode

results.name: round_half_off
results.why: the rounding constant is a whole unit, not a half

results.name: saturation_to_zero
results.why: a part that the rounding carries to 2**(W-1) becomes zero instead of saturating

results.name: left_shift_zero_ext
results.why: a negative word is zero-extended before the shift

results.name: acc_bank
results.why: the exponent is taken from the OR of the bank being written, not the one being read

results.name: write_bank_stuck
results.why: the write bank never changes: a frame overwrites the one before it

results.name: read_bank_stuck
results.why: the read bank never changes: the first frame's bank is read again

results.name: bank_wrap_early
results.why: the write bank wraps one bank early: the last bank is never used

results.name: mem_banks_overlap
results.why: every frame is written into the first bank's addresses

results.name: read_bank_zero
results.why: every frame is read from the first bank's addresses

results.name: order_unreversed
results.why: the pair index is not bit reversed on reading: bit-reversed order out

results.name: pair_written_swapped
results.why: the two samples of a pair exchanged on the way into the store

results.name: odd_read_slice
results.why: the odd real part read from the odd imaginary slice

results.name: tlast_early
results.why: tlast one beat early

results.name: exp_not_aligned
results.why: the exponent is two clocks ahead of the data (visible when frames follow each other with different levels)

results.name: hold_missing
results.why: the read-out does not stall: beats are lost while the sink is not ready

results.name: rd_not_held
results.why: the memory output register is not held while the output is stalled

results.name: exp_reg_not_held
results.why: the exponent pipeline register is not held while the output is stalled
